summary: Master research design and statistical analysis with our SPSS course. Gain essential skills to interpret data and elevate your research projects to new heights.
lede: Research design and statistical analysis with SPSS help research teams plan studies, prepare dependable datasets, and interpret findings responsibly. For professionals who collect, prepare, analyze, or communicate research data, the course covers shaping research questions and sampling plans, documenting and cleaning data, and selecting suitable statistical procedures. Learners use SPSS to examine distributions, test reliability, compare groups, assess associations, and build an introductory regression summary for clear reporting.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who collect, prepare, analyze, or communicate research data and need a structured SPSS workflow without assuming advanced mathematics or programming experience.
prerequisites: Prerequisites: No prior SPSS or programming experience is required. You should have basic numeracy, familiarity with spreadsheets, and a research question or example dataset to use during exercises. Coding is not required for completion, although the course introduces optional SPSS syntax for repeatable data preparation. Advanced concepts such as complex survey weighting, imputation programming, and production-scale automation receive conceptual or operational coverage rather than technical engineering treatment.
